title: Turning a 2D character into sprite animation
author: Interesting-Area6418
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/fjm0v44dm7og1.gif

For the last two months me and my brother have been working on a 2D sprite sheet generation tool using AI. You give it a single 2D image and it converts it into character animations.



This has been a grind. We both are students and burned a fair amount of money on RunPod while training models and generating samples. We tried different setups, failed a lot, and slowly started getting better results. Now we are finally at a point where we feel good about how it looks.



We have also been seeing many people building similar things and some of the work out there is genuinely amazing. We really want to be part of that space and learn alongside others who are experimenting and building.



Right now the model can generate running, walking and idle animations. The samples we are sharing are raw outputs directly from our diffusion model.



We are also working on post processing like automatic background removal and pixel cleanup using mathematical and algorithmic approaches for pixelation. We will share those results in the next 1 to 2 days.



If you guys find these results interesting, we will release a v1 by hosting the model on the cloud so others can try it out as well.



If that sounds interesting, feel free to join the Discord and stay in touch.

DISCORD LINK  
[https://discord.gg/MSrHYhfC](https://discord.gg/MSrHYhfC)

  
Also would love to hear feedback on these samples.
